fills.name: Highland Cattle grazing
fills.quote: 高地牛 高地牛在浆果丛旁觅食以获得食物。进食时每分钟可产出 30 食物。初始产量为 9，每建造一个高地地标，产量增加 4。
fills.note: Read from the in-game civ overview on the early-access build. Cap starts at 9 and rises by 4 per Highland landmark. Grazing yields 30 food per minute per cattle.
fills.verdictReason: Page loaded via api.bilibili.com: video '黑桐谷歌【帝国时代4北境掠夺者】DLC试玩报告' (empty description, no subtitles). The text is not in the page metadata. It is on screen in the video at ~2:06: I downloaded the 480p stream and extracted the frame at 126s, which shows the Scots civ overview. The 高地牛 unit card reads '高地牛在浆果丛旁觅食以获得食物。进食时每分钟可产出 30 食物。初始产量为 9，每建造一个高地地标，产量增加 4。' The literal word is 产量, not 上限. Food output is given separately as 30/min, and the 高地财富 bonus on the same screen says '每建造一个高地地标，牛群容量提升'. So the 9 (+4 per landmark) is the starting herd capacity, and cap=9 is supported. This is a pre-release DLC preview build.
